text_block_list.text:
Since Mejiro Ardan wasn't feeling well,
I had her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for causing you concern.
If you'll excuse me, I will go lie down for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(—Familiar scenery and smells.
In the end, hospital rooms will always haunt my life.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...Still, right now, someone is waiting for me to run. I must ensure I get into peak condition.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —What's going on...? My body feels so light... and there's something else...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Power is surging through my legs...!
I've never felt like this before—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
With these legs... there are no limits.
I can gallop as much as I want, wherever I please—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to run endlessly, on and on...!
With how I am right now, I can—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes even dreams... can leave you
with such a bright and refreshing feeling.

Perhaps thanks to having a restful break,
Mejiro Ardan seems to have recovered her energy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Am I not even allowed to dream,
even within my dreams...?

Despite resting, Mejiro Ardan's condition
didn't seem to improve...
